envelope.description: Document the automatic defaults and the Build section

body.title: Document the automatic defaults and the Build section
body.summary: In docs/daemon.md, extend the 'Build commands' section: the defaults written at repo add (which types, never overwriting, the buildDefaults result, that a default is a guess the user edits), buildSetup and the 'use suggested' action for repos with none, and the Build section on each client's Repo Configuration page.
acceptanceChecks: docs/daemon.md describes the add-time defaults, the types they cover and that nothing is overwritten
It describes buildSetup, the suggestion and the Build section on the terminal, VS Code and JetBrains pages
It says a default is a typical command, not a verified one, and where to change it

tests.name: docs/daemon.md: the Build commands section is read against the shipped behaviour and states the add-time defaults, buildSetup and the Build section
